title: git-flower-garden configuration
description: Configuration version 1. git-flower-garden validates more than this schema can express (IANA time zones, duplicate repository ids, URL safety); run `git-flower-garden validate-config` for the full check.

host.description: Loopback only. Serving on a network needs authentication that does not exist yet.

businessDays.description: Show every commit from the start of the Nth most recent business date through now.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone, e.g. America/New_York. Defaults to the system time zone.

maxRecentCommits.description: Show at most this many of the newest commits from the recent window in each repository; older ones fold into dashed stems with a hidden count. Branch heads, their common ancestors, and worktree HEADs are always shown. Unlimited when omitted.

renderer.description: The view the browser opens on until the viewer picks another: a renderer id from src/ui/renderers/registry.ts, such as technical, canvas, svg, or pixel. An id the browser does not know falls back to its default.

environment.description: Real-time sky from the Sun and Moon, computed offline; there is no automatic location lookup. Without a place, the sky is Blacksburg, Virginia's. Nothing is sent anywhere unless weather is enabled.

enabled.description: Follow the real Sun, Moon, and stars. When false, the garden is lit by the noon Sun.

latitude.description: Degrees north (negative for south). Give both coordinates, or neither for Blacksburg, Virginia (37.2296, -80.4139).

longitude.description: Degrees east (negative for west). Give both coordinates, or neither for Blacksburg, Virginia.

elevationMeters.description: Meters above sea level. Defaults to 0 with your own coordinates, 634 for Blacksburg.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone for the local time shown with the sky. Defaults to history.timeZone with your own coordinates, America/New_York for Blacksburg.

weather.description: Optional weather from MET Norway's free forecast service (CC BY 4.0). Off by default: when enabled, the place above (rounded to about 11 m) is sent to api.met.no about every half hour. The conditions shown are a model forecast for the hour, not a local observation. Has no effect when the sky is off.

enabled.description: Fetch the weather for the configured place.

provider.description: The weather provider. MET Norway is the only one for now (ADR 0020).

contact.description: Optional email or web address added to the requests' User-Agent, as MET Norway's terms ask, so they can reach you instead of blocking the app.

id.description: Stable identity for layout and caches. Renaming the label keeps the plot.

path.description: Local repository or worktree. Relative paths are resolved against this file's directory.

url.description: Remote-only repository: https, http, ssh, git, or file URL, or user@host:path. No inline passwords or access tokens: use a credential helper or SSH agent.

remotes.description: For a local path: remotes to monitor through git-flower-garden's own cache.

github.description: GitHub repository (owner/name) whose push events trigger a fetch. Derived automatically for github.com URLs.

webhooks.description: Optional GitHub push notifications (see the user guide). Polling stays on as a safety net.

host.description: Loopback only; expose the receiver through a tunnel or reverse proxy you run.

secretEnv.description: Environment variable that holds the webhook secret. The secret itself never goes in this file.
